CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Redemption after the Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Say Redemption after the Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Redemption after the Fall of Man.
   C. Use Redemption after the Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Redemption after the Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship Over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stewardship Over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Stewardship Over Creation has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship Over Creation.
   D. Apply the teaching of Stewardship Over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

5. Which response best shows understanding of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean ? (1 mark)
   A. Say The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean .
   D. Use The New Testament Books 2.2 Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ 2.3 Galilean  to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Old Testament Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Old Testament Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Old Testament Prophets.
   C. Say The Old Testament Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Old Testament Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Cheating in exams

8. Which response best shows understanding of Loyalty to God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Loyalty to God.
   B. Use Loyalty to God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Loyalty to God has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Loyalty to God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Bible.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings of Prophet Amos? (1 mark)
   A. Use Teachings of Prophet Amos to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Teachings of Prophet Amos has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teachings of Prophet Amos with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings of Prophet Amos.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Sinai Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Sinai Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Sinai Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Sinai Covenant has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Sinai Covenant.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top.
   B. Use Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Methods of Studying the Holy Bible o Inductive o Devotional o Biographical o Top with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The New Testament Books and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Infancy and Early Life of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Galilean Ministry 2.4 Paul’s First Letter to the Corinthians 3.0 Church in Actio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Galilean Ministry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. (4 marks)
